svg.title: One match day of the 1998 World Cup
svg.desc: The XGBoost run on the 1998 World Cup trace: offered load, requests missed so far and ready pods for each setup over the replayed day. Scored from noon: HPA+ missed 204 requests and the HPA formula 570. Most of the HPA formula's misses came at the 16:00 kick-off, when load doubled within a minute of the run.
svg.text: One match day of the 1998 World Cup
Requests per second of the World Cup web site from 06:00 on 26 June to 06:00 on 27 June 1998, played 8 times
faster and scaled so the busiest moment is 75 requests per second. Scoring starts at noon; before that the setups only watched.
